clips.title: The story
paras: The Grimtotem have seized Greatwood Vale in the eastern foothills of the Stonetalon Mountains. The perilous Webwinder Path leads into the forested valley, which the tribe now uses to launch bloody assaults on nearby settlements.

Greatwood Vale has become a violent frontier off the Webwinder Path. Grundig Darkcloud leads the Grimtotem who have moved into the vale in force. They block safe passage and terrorize the surrounding foothills.

From Greatwood Vale, Grimtotem raiders swept into nearby Camp Aparaje and slaughtered nearly every tauren there. Makaba Flathoof escaped the attack. Now she directs vengeful Horde warriors into the heart of the vale to kill the renegade Grimtotem and end Grundig Darkcloud's rule.
